description: The hosted tracker moved v4 to v5 on 2026-08-04 and the events table has no record of it: migrate_backend/migrate_db update meta.schema_version inside _write_txn but never call log_event, unlike freeze, unfreeze and config which all do. Discovered empirically - the DB was already v5 before this session ran migrate, and querying events for a migrate action returned nothing, so who migrated and when cannot be recovered. This matters because migrate is step 0 of the destructive todo-db 0.3 cutover runbook: the one structural write whose provenance the runbook depends on is the one write that leaves no trace, and the audit chain still verifies without it.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/ -q -k migrate_audit
verifications.expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree - no such test exists and migrate emits no event today
